supersession.reason: The user clarified that zero teacher-relative generation loss remains the moonshot target, but a small measured loss is acceptable for an independently fluent English core. Specialist-domain extraction is secondary to preventing specialist material from entering that core.

primary_objective: Acquire a broadly fluent, teacher-free English core in the existing fast LayerCake architecture from a frozen open-weight teacher while keeping all declared specialist material outside the English acquisition payload.
priority_order: broad autonomous English fluency and coherence
LayerCake CPU speed, TTFT, memory, sparse execution, and canonical ABI preservation
lowest passing tested core and imported-information point

allowed: small LayerCake bridges, projections, task cakes, or fused low-rank deltas
fact-safe supplied contexts and abstract or nonce task content
forbidden_at_inference: prompt-template lookup handlers used to pass evaluation prompts

selection_stages.purpose: Test whether clean sequence depth fixes the v47 failure without symbolic handlers.
Select capacity and information budget on broad prompt families and the disclosed post-certificate failure suite.
Screen the exact selected candidate on disjoint prompts and source-relative behavior.
Certify one exact teacher-free candidate only after architecture, budget, and decoding are frozen.

quality_gates.claim_rule: A candidate meeting the minimum acceptable fluent-core gate but not the moonshot target is labeled FLUENT_WITH_MEASURED_TEACHER_RELATIVE_LOSS, never quality-equivalent or lossless.

minimum_frontier_rule: After fluency and execution pass, test nested imported-information and trainable-capacity points. Report the lowest passing tested point with its adjacent lower failure; never claim a global mathematical minimum.
promotion_rule: Do not promote scaffolding, a synthetic-template pass, or a candidate that borrows speed from another lineage. Promotion requires the same exact teacher-free LayerCake candidate to pass the minimum fluent-core, segregation, execution, identity, untouched-final, and adversarial gates. Continue toward the zero-regression moonshot target even when a fluent interim core is preserved.
